title: BC Friday Tips #71 BlankZero Property
summary: The BlankZero property on numeric fields can be set to true to display empty values instead of zero, reducing visual clutter and helping users focus on meaningful data in optional fields.
key_points: BlankZero property controls whether numeric fields display 0 or remain empty by default
Setting BlankZero to true improves UI cleanliness for optional numeric fields
Users can better distinguish between meaningful data and default zero values
This is a simple property change that enhances overall usability

quotes.text: Set BlankZero = true to display empty instead of zero.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core action developers can take to improve field display behavior

quotes.text: Cleaner UI, less clutter. Helps users focus on meaningful data.
quotes.why_it_matters: These are the key benefits that explain why developers should use this property
